activity.notes: FAMSI's synthesis of Classic Maya royal dynasties gives Itzamnaaj Bahlam III of Yaxchilan a reign of 681-742 CE. Older publications vary in ruler numbering and orthography; ATLAS therefore uses the explicit Itzamnaaj Bahlam III identification tied to the 681-742 reign rather than treating a bare B'alam number as sufficient identity.

sources.title: Maya Royal Dynasties, Part III — FAMSI
sources.citation_text: FAMSI's dynasty reference identifies Itzamnaaj Bahlam III at Yaxchilan and gives his reign as AD 681-742 while documenting variant numbering conventions.
